summary: At main 6e46a576, JOVRA has a bounded native iOS recording/review/export flow and substantial executable Python Studio/Room contracts. Premium film production, native multi-camera coordination, Android, watches and hosted processing remain roadmap work. Open foundation PRs378/379 do not refute those usability gaps.

strengths.title: Executable Studio intelligence
strengths.detail: Actual Python keeper/progress rules, RulesPlanner, EDL compiler and exact PTS normalization exist; do not describe Studio as zero code or merely images.

strengths.title: Concrete Room trust and watch freshness contracts
strengths.detail: Schemas/reference state machines/fixtures cover approval, replay protection, freshness and receipts; docs distinguish rule validation from actual transport/watch behavior.

strengths.title: Security-aware backend groundwork
strengths.detail: Local Supabase tester restrictions, identity/membership RLS and role tests exist; gateway contracts cover41 routes. Hosted activation is separate.

strengths.title: Honest watch scope
strengths.detail: Design mirrors acknowledged phone state, freezes remote elapsed values, and keeps commands pending until receipts; no live serve speed or watch In/Out decisions.

findings.title: Premium Studio remains an implementation frontier
findings.detail: CONFIRMED after refutation. Main contains no Studio Swift packages/features or native film-production UI; project links Core/Media only. Python emits plans, not customer films. Open379 adds package wiring, schema headers and source-clock arithmetic; actual media source explicitly leaves ingest, renderer and verifier to later work. This is a readiness gap, not a claim Python is fake.
findings.fix: Integrate reviewed foundation379; implement native contract ports, project/store/UI, verified ingest/proxies, deterministic renderer and FilmVerifier.

findings.title: Benchmark scaffold is not automatic tennis analysis
findings.detail: CONFIRMED. EstimatorRegistry contains oracle.eventTimes/null.eventTimes self-tests only. Benchmark tooling is not app-linked. Audio hit detection and rally segmentation disabled/no lastBenchmark; trajectory/automatic placement/outcomes/line calling unsupported. Estimated pose/serve registry labels describe permitted methods, not native implementation proof. Processing/ServeLab remain route placeholders.
findings.fix: Implement candidate estimators and analysis UI, benchmark synthetic plus independently labelled real footage, promote capabilities only through recorded gates.

findings.title: Six-camera/watch experience remains protocol work
findings.detail: CONFIRMED. No native Room carrier, WCSession bridge, watch target or Wear app on main; Room README explicitly disclaims those implementations. Open foundation PRs do not implement them. QR pairing, recording acknowledgements/reconnect and watch health remain unverified product work.
findings.fix: Implement S69-S73/native bridges/UI against contracts; pass two-phone/paired-watch gates before six-device endurance.

findings.title: Android foundation is not a functioning Android app
findings.detail: Main has no android directory/Kotlin/Gradle project. Open378 is genuine groundwork but manifest application is empty and delegates activity/theme to A02. All99 Android issues remain open. iPad target-family support does not establish adaptive/foldable state preservation.
findings.fix: Finish/review foundation, shell, Kotlin parity/store/media, then adaptive matrices and independent physical capture.

findings.title: Hosted account/storage customer flows unfinished
findings.detail: Local backend exists; no gateway/render implementation or hosted execution evidence in audited tree. Account/Drive management are native placeholders; Drive configuration reports not configured without operator config. External user-owned Supabase/Cloudflare accounts were not inspected and are not classified absent.
findings.fix: Complete migrations/gateway/uploads/orchestration/render/account/deletion/providers, then separately capture G1-G9 evidence with operator authorization.

findings.title: Mission resume state contradicts later authorization
findings.detail: PLAN records2026-10-11 step5 green light, merged PRs and public repo transition; state.json still says restore billing/merge those PRs/holdstep5. Live repo PUBLIC. Current chat boundary still applies, but October9 state is not current repository-wide truth.
findings.fix: Reconcile heartbeat from fresh remote evidence; retain history and distinguish later Claude authorization from current chat scope.

findings.title: Backend status table understates contract work
findings.detail: README labels contracts Not started but backend/contracts contains S81 implementation and mapped issue closed.
findings.fix: Update contract status separately from unimplemented gateway/render.

remaining: Native Studio foundation, typed Swift parity, project persistence and actual screens, verified single-camera films before multi-angle output.
Candidate hit/rally/pose/manual-assisted estimators, processing/UI and independent real-footage gates.
Native authenticated Room transport, QR approval, receipts/reconnect/freshness, two-phone proof and six-phone endurance.
Actual account, optional Drive/restore/providers without making capture depend on account/network.
Android build/shell/domain/store/media/adaptive and separate physical capture.
Native watch ports/bridges/surfaces/acknowledged commands and real pairing/background gates.
Human gates open: S54 scored original footage, S67 two-phone footage, S74 six-phone field session, S104 hosted activation.

evidence.method: gh issue list --state all --limit1000 joined to committed ticket-issue maps
evidence.qualification: All mapped tickets resolved; T includesT01 while tickets.json listsT02-T63; W includes22 watch+4 iOS-adaptive. Workflow counts are not implementation percentages; dependencies overlap.

evidence.result: 38 feature source files call RoutePlaceholder; component discloses unfinished screens. Navigation success is not feature implementation.

Read exact open378 manifest(empty application, shell deferred) and379 production packages(schema/header helpers and nominalEnd only; renderer/verifier deferred) through GitHub API. Main source inventory found only Core/Media packages, no Studio/Android/watch native implementation. Python Studio compiler/planner and Room reference explicitly preserved as actual code, not dismissed.

Only oracle/null registered; benchmark product explicitly tooling-only/not app-linked. Disabled statuses and absent benchmark separate from estimated pose/serve labels; no runtime/model-accuracy claim.
Read-only source/live issue audit; no repo edits/GitHub mutations/compiler/decoder/simulator/hosted tests; existing receipts not rerun.
